Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'My Goddess... [Pause(2.5)]Are you sure of the course of action? [Pause(2.5)]]
[Wavy:We could all flee, [Pause(1)]we have the resources left for a full evacuation.']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'No matter to where we flee, the] [Wavy:[Shaking:[Scale(2):[Colors(FFD500):Godseeker]]]] [Wavy:and his troops will]
[Wavy:always be one step away. Even if we hid beneath the deepest of waters]
[Wavy:nothing will stop the wrath soon approaching.']

Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'Can't we erase any trail? Hide until his ultimate passing?]
[Wavy:Fake your death?!']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'...Oh, Amidias. I couldn't have wished for a better king.]
[Wavy:But the truth is...']

Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'Please, don't tell me you believe him.']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'...In his deathbed, [Colors(00FFD5):Vetrasyl] confessed to me.]
[Wavy:Of his weakness in the face of danger and shame of his escape.]
[Wavy:Despite his pleas to carry on his will,]
[Wavy:his sureness that he was entrusting the right woman,]
[Wavy:I knew that once I consumed his Soul, I would be a sinner.']

Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'...Otonilou, I will not...']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'But none of you are.']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'I have bared my sin for longer than that man's wretched walk upon our planet,]
[Wavy:but my people were never sinners!]
[Wavy:None of you deserve this fate, to be erased from memory!]
[Wavy:And on this day, Amidias...']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'If I am a sinner,]
[Wavy:then my death shall wash away the sins of all who call themselves Ilmerans.]
[Wavy:I shall burn with our nation so that those who yet live may rise from its ashes,]
[Wavy:all free from the sin of your Gods!']

Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'My Goddess, I... I...']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'Shed not a tear, Amidias.]
[Wavy:I know this is a tall order, but I wouldn't be giving it to you]
[Wavy:if I did not trust in your resolve. So heed me... When the time comes,]
[Wavy:guide our people. To a new home, where the sun shines even in the deepest of waters.']

Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'...It shall be done, my Goddess.]
[Wavy:I shall not perish, not until a future for our kind is secured.]
[Wavy:This, I promise.']

Pages.Speaker: Amidias
Lines: [Wavy:'It was an honor to serve you, Otonilou.']

Pages.Speaker: Otonilou
Lines: [Wavy:'And it was an honor to have met you, my king.']
